title: FBI Photo B011
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white video or targeting surveillance frame with overlay
pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a targeting or surveillance display. A white crosshair reticle is centered, with a vertical and horizontal axis marked by tick marks and numeric scale labels reading 15, 10, 5 on both sides of center. The background is a noisy gray gradient with faint darker shapes resembling terrain or mountains along the lower portion. Several black rectangular blocks (appearing to be redactions or overlay bars) are positioned on the left and right sides at three vertical levels. A small dark dot appears just right of center. A white timestamp overlay is in the lower-left corner.
